newsitem.title: USA: AM International gets financial commitment.
newsitem.headline: AM International gets financial commitment.

text.p: AM International Inc said Thursday it received a three-year capital financing commitment from Foothill Capital Corp, providing for a secured credit line of up to $10.0 million.
The agreement is subject to borrowing base limitations and certain other conditions, including negotiation and execution of final documents, among other things.
The credit line will be used for general corporate purposes.

"The credit line, combined with existing cash balances of approximately $27 million, provide the company with the cash resources to achieve its growth objectives as a distributor in the graphics art industry," Thomas Rooney, chief financial officer, said in a statement.
As previously announced, AM International will pay a $2.00 a share special cash dividend to shareholders of record as of May 13.
